request.what: Fund Pallas by TxPipe for Year 2 maintenance of Cardano core Rust libraries over 12 months.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates that re-implement core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
Projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC and others rely on Pallas for low-level protocol details.
Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 downloads on crates.io.
The maintainer will perform code maintenance, community support, and AI-workflow compatibility improvements to keep Pallas usable, reliable, and up to date for downstream projects.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, multi-party authorization roles, and an external Oversight Committee.
A public dashboard and on-chain records are available for the community to audit and track the withdrawn ADA.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, routed through Intersect-administered smart contracts with stated oversight, milestone controls, and external references for budget voting, smart contracts, audits, and dashboard tracking.
